falsifiers.name: DIRECT_PLAN_REASON_CODE_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH
falsifiers.observation: RestartContinuationPlan.__post_init__ validates reason_code only as non-empty text while plan_restart_continuation deterministically maps each disposition to one canonical reason code. Direct construction can therefore serialize a semantically contradictory disposition/reason pair even after disposition/reference/effect-flag invariants are repaired.
required_regressions: cross-paired disposition/reason codes fail closed under direct RestartContinuationPlan construction

contradictions: The G2 required invariants bind disposition/reference/effect-flag combinations but do not yet explicitly bind reason_code to disposition, while the planner itself treats that mapping as deterministic semantics.
completion_deficit: Before G2 terminalization, independently test disposition-to-reason semantic binding so exported direct construction cannot create contradictory deterministic recovery receipts.
next_exact_action: Canonical WP901 G2 mutation owner should either add reason-code/disposition constructor invariants and regressions in the existing G2 scope, or reject this candidate with an explicit semantic contract reason before terminal reconciliation.
